items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MzkxNjcsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--68ba50d43f84f132fe5e5257672a4fd6a695d606/image.png) **¡Te invitamos al increíble Baja Spring 2025!** ¡El primer torneo de 3 días en Baja California que NO te puedes perder! Ven a disfrutar de todas las categorías de NxN y sumérgete en la emoción de los eventos silenciosos. ¡Baja Cubing y el Museo del Trompo se unen para llevar el speedcubing al siguiente nivel en Baja California! ¡Será un evento épico que marcará historia, con adrenalina, velocidad y mucha diversión! ¡Nos vemos en Baja Spring 2025! Esta es una competencia avalada por la WCA, por lo que todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados con el [reglamento](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). **We invite you to the incredible Baja Spring 2025!** The first 3-day tournament in Baja California that you CANNOT miss! Come enjoy all the NxN categories and dive into the excitement of the silent events. Baja Cubing and the Museum of the Spinning Top are joining forces to take speedcubing to the next level in Baja California! It will be an epic event that will make history, full of adrenaline, speed, and tons of fun! See you at Baja Spring 2025! This is a WCA-approved competition, so all competitors must be familiar with the [regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).

items.name: FMCow Ohio State V 2025

organisers.name: [{Carson Miller}{mailto:xsedim@gmail.com}] [{Keenan Darkins}{mailto:darkins.kb@gmail.com}] [{The Rubik's Cube Club at Ohio State}{mailto:ohiostatecubeclub@gmail.com}]

items.information: This competition takes place on a **Friday Evening** and will only feature ***Fewest Moves and 7x7x7.*** This competition is not recommended for newcomers. If this would be your first competition, we recommend looking at other competitions in [Ohio.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=all&search=ohio&state=present&year=all+years&from_date=&to_date=&delegate=&display=list) Only one guest per competitor is permitted. Please consider coming without a guest as spectator seating will be limited.
